title: aidd stack
description: One stack in aidd's library (`stacks/<name>.toml`): opinionated standards that go together, plus the `[project.stack]` entries they bring. A stack holds no rule text of its own. `aidd stack add` copies its standards into a project.

name.description: The stack's name, the file's stem, such as `python-cli`.

description.description: What the stack is for, in one sentence.

extends.description: One other stack this one builds on, one level deep: a stack that extends a stack that extends another is refused, and so is a cycle.

standards.description: Ids of active opinionated standards in the library, at most one per open choice and ecosystem.

project.description: Entries `aidd stack add` merges into the project's config.

stack.description: Technologies for the project's radar, as in `[project.stack]`.

reviewed.description: The day a person last reviewed the stack.

owner.description: The person or team who keeps the stack current; never an agent.

items.description: Technologies by name, such as `uv` or `pytest`.
